Hi Julia — thanks for the spreadsheet, this is perfect to start with. Looping in Marcus (finance) and Ben (sales) so we can give a complete answer.

High level so you know what to expect:
- If the customer purchases via a cloud marketplace listing (AWS/Azure/GCP) the invoice will often be issued by the marketplace operator or by Redwood depending on the marketplace program (co‑sell vs. ISV listing). That changes tax paperwork and remittance.
- For direct Redwood invoices we will ask for the W‑9 for US entities and W‑8BEN/W‑8BEN‑E for non‑US entities as appropriate.
- For EU entities we will need VAT registration numbers if Acme expects a reverse‑charge or zero‑rated sale.

Marcus — can you confirm the preferred process to accept marketplace invoices (i.e., do we accept marketplace operator invoices, or does Redwood always make the customer‑facing invoice for co‑sell deals)? Also please flag any paperwork we will need from Acme beyond W‑9/W‑8 (e.g., VAT certificates).

I attached our internal one‑pager that summarizes typical marketplace flows for AWS/Azure/GCP — it may help map rows in your spreadsheet.

Best,

Thanks — adding a few finance specifics here.

Laura's summary is correct. For clarity:
1) AWS Marketplace (paid via AWS): invoice normally comes from AWS; AWS remits and pays Redwood under our seller agreement. In that case, Acme will receive an invoice from AWS (with AWS tax handling). No W‑9/W‑8 is required by Redwood to issue that AWS invoice, but we still need entity mapping to ensure revenue is booked correctly and to reconcile marketplace reports.
2) Azure Marketplace co‑sell / transactable offers: depending on program, either Microsoft invoices and pays Redwood, or Redwood issues the invoice (if we opt to be the billing party). If Microsoft invoices, VAT handling is on Microsoft side for EU purchases — again we need entity mapping.
3) Direct invoice (purchase outside of marketplace): Redwood will invoice Acme directly and we will require a completed W‑9 (US entity) or W‑8BEN‑E (non‑US) plus any VAT registration docs where applicable.

Action items for Acme:
- Mark column B in the spreadsheet with the preferred billing path for each entity (Marketplace / Direct).
- For Marketplace rows, indicate whether Acme needs AWS/Azure to be the billing party or prefer Redwood to appear on the invoice (some legal teams prefer to see Redwood directly).
- Provide W‑9 / VAT numbers as attachments for the entities you expect to be invoiced directly.

Our ask: if any EU subsidiary expects a reverse‑charge, please attach VAT registration for that entity. We can fast‑track setup for co‑sell enabling once the mapping is confirmed.

On timelines — if you confirm mapping this week we can set the billing path before your pilot goes live next month.

— Marcus
